name: C2PSA (CSP block with position-sensitive attention)

whatIsIt.eli5: A step where every spot of the small picture looks at all the other spots to understand the whole scene.
whatIsIt.simple: A block at the end of the YOLO11/YOLO26 backbone. It splits the map in two halves; one half goes through PSABlocks (self-attention plus a small feed-forward part), then both halves are joined.
whatIsIt.engineer: cv1 (1×1) → split (c, c) → n × PSABlock(c, attn_ratio=0.5, heads=c/64) on the second half → concat → cv2 (1×1). Requires c1 == c2.

whyExists.eli5: Small patterns are not enough to tell a weed from a crop; sometimes the whole scene helps.
whyExists.simple: Convolutions only look at nearby pixels. Attention lets each cell use information from anywhere in the map. At stride 32 the map is small (20×20), so attention is affordable there.
whyExists.engineer: Global context via MHSA where N = H·W is small (400 at 640 input); the CSP split halves the attention width and cost.

eli5: Cut the notes into two piles.
One pile: every spot checks every other spot and borrows useful notes.
simple: cv1 makes 2c channels and splits them in half.
Each PSABlock: attention (every position mixes information from all positions), then a small 2-layer feed-forward network; both with shortcuts.
The untouched half and the attended half are joined and mixed by cv2.
engineer: Attention: qkv 1×1 conv, key_dim = head_dim·0.5, softmax(qᵀk·scale), v·attn, plus a 3×3 depthwise positional conv on v, then proj.
Cost O(N²) in positions, so only used at P5.

example.eli5: In YOLO11n it works on a 20×20 picture with 256 layers of notes.
example.simple: YOLO11n layer 10: 256 → 256 channels at 20×20 (400 positions), one PSABlock with 2 heads, 249,728 parameters.

typicalPositions.eli5: At the very end of the backbone.
typicalPositions.simple: Right after SPPF at the end of the backbone (YOLO11, YOLO26).

tradeoffs.eli5: Looking everywhere costs a lot on big pictures.
tradeoffs.simple: Attention cost grows with the square of the number of positions, so it would be very expensive on the larger P3 map.
tradeoffs.engineer: O((HW)²·d) matmuls; prefer area/window attention at higher resolution.
